characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. Reference image 2 is the character sheet cell of Shibata (45, broad confident face, slicked-back black hair, thin RIMLESS glasses, clean-shaven, NO earrings, NO lapel pin, NO mole): copy this exact face, hairstyle, eyewear and age; the WARDROBE follows the [CHARACTER] text below (it changes by scene); ignore its background, framing and any sheet layout. Reference image 3 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders, labels or wall papers. FRAMING LOCKED FIRST: chest-up MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, the speaker's face at least ONE THIRD of the frame height; NOT a wide shot, NO full body, NO legs. GAZE LOCKED: eyes look at Kenji off-screen LEFT, head turned 30 to 40 degrees away from the lens; the eyes NEVER look into the camera lens. Nobody holds a phone; NO smartphone in any hand. GAZE LOCKED: Shibata's head is tilted DOWN and turned about 30 degrees toward screen LEFT; his EYES LOOK DOWN at the document and the wooden hanko under his index finger on the table (he is pointing at the signature box while he speaks); the eyes are NEVER raised to the lens, no eye contact with the camera; a slight contemptuous half-smile; NO lapel pin, NO badge. [CAMERA] eye-level, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh, the face fills at least one third of the frame height. Single speaker at 30 to 40 degrees from the camera axis, eyes toward the other person off-screen, NOT looking at the camera, the face at least one third of the frame height, mouth closed. NO foreground person, no other people. Photorealistic live-action Japanese noir drama, contemporary Tokyo (Reiwa era), Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, low-key high-contrast lighting, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, no flat lighting. [CHARACTER] IDENTITY FIRST — Shibata, a Japanese man aged 45, broad confident face, slicked-back black hair, thin RIMLESS glasses, clean-shaven, no earrings, no lapel pin, no mole, wearing a plain navy double-breasted suit, white shirt, plain grey necktie, no lapel pin, no badge. Shibata wears thin RIMLESS glasses. [ACTION] Chest-up close-up of Shibata at three-quarter angle, pushing a small wooden seal (hanko) across the table with one finger toward Kenji (screen LEFT), then tapping the blank signature box of the document twice. [NEGATIVE] gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, brand logos, watermarks, stamps with characters, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, anime, 3d render, illustration, thick glossy gel tears, cartoon sweat drops, multiple tear streams on both cheeks, earrings on men, LED light strips, lens flare text. NO signs, NO whiteboard writing, NO name plates; the wall clock face is blank; all papers blank. MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, the camera about 1.5 metres from the speaker: the speaker's head is near the top edge of the frame and the frame is cut at mid-chest, so the speaker's head and shoulders fill the centre of the frame and the face is about one third of the frame height (NOT a wide shot, NOT full body, the room is only a blurred background).
